evidence: The paper reports only prediction performance metrics (median AUC) across simulation scenarios and real rheumatoid arthritis data. Results state: "median AUC: 0.66" for MB-MDR, "0.54" for Random Forest, and "0.50" for Elastic Net when interactions are present. No variable importance measures, feature rankings, or impurity-based metrics (MDI, Gini) appear anywhere in the text. Discussion and conclusion focus solely on prediction performance improvement with interaction-aware models, not variable selection or importance ranking.
